summary: A7 core amendments: contract 23.2 decisions D1, D2 and D3 are applied in PainterIO.Core and everything is green. Note: the code and test edits were made by an earlier A7 session (06:53-09:23) that stopped before writing this report; this session reviewed every change against the contract, re-ran the whole verification and wrote the report. D1 (CaptureSolver.cs): Rim = trail cells 8-adjacent to an Interior cell (one 3x3 scan per trail cell after the step (iii) flood; the floods stay 4-connected, so what is enclosed is unchanged). The independent two-flood oracle of CaptureTests (ReferenceCapture) and the polygon interior + rim checker now use the 8-neighbourhood, and every C1-C7 scenario plus 325 random cases still match the solver exactly. C2 is unchanged: all 5 back-and-forth cases (incl. the diagonal ones) capture 0 cells because a bare line has no Interior, hence no Rim. C1 re-checked: 253.61 u^2 captured vs 249.98 u^2 analytic, +1.45 % (tolerance 3 %, not touched); the 8-adjacency Rim only adds the outer corner cells of an axis-aligned outline. New test C1_DiagonalEdgeRimIsCapturedWithoutStairNotches: a 45-degree leg is captured with its whole staircase (more than a third of the leg cells are D1-only cells) and a parallel glide line stays on captured cells. The wave A test R7_GlidingAlongAnOwnDiagonalEdgeFlickersHarmlessly (67 empty Exit/Return pairs in 2 s on a hand-painted notched edge) is replaced by R7_GlidingAlongAnOwnCapturedDiagonalEdgeNoLongerFlickers, which asserts the new expectation in a real Simulation: trip 1 captures a region with a 45-degree edge, trip 2 glides 6.4 u along that captured edge with zero events, unchanged territory and Home all the time. Its non-vacuity half replays the same glide with the D1 cells set back to neutral (exactly the territory the 4-adjacency Rim produced): 38 empty Exit/Return pairs in 1.5 s, no owner change, no cut, Captures unchanged (D2). D2 (EventResolver.cs step a, PlayerState comment): Captures++ only when the applied cells (after the R18 conflict rule) are non-empty; the Return event is still emitted for every return. New test R7_CapturesCountsOnlyReturnsWithCellsButEveryReturnIsEmitted at 30/60/144 Hz (a poke with an empty Return then a real excursion: 2 Return events, Captures == 1, exact cell count 81 = interior 56 + side rim 23 + 2 D1 corner cells); the GR-Edge sim test also asserts Captures == 0 for its empty return. D3 (Arena.cs): on a hold, Arena.Step now advances along the desired displacement d up to the inset line (64-step bisection on t that always keeps the last point with SignedDistance <= -Margin, so no clamp is needed and the result is within rounding of the line), and a head already within HoldSnap = 1e-11 of the line stays exactly in place. New tests: R4_Arena_Step_HeldStopPointDoesNotDependOnTheStepLength (East wall, South wall and corner arc, step lengths of 30/60/144/240 Hz: same stop point within 1e-9 u, on the line, on the straight path, then held exactly) and R4_HeldStopPointIsOnTheInsetLineAndIdenticalAtEveryRate (Simulation at 30/60/144 Hz: three players held on the East wall, on the West wall with a 5-degree tilt, and on a corner arc; held positions identical within 1e-9 u across rates; the following wall run and return give identical outcomes under the 10.0 protocol). R4_BorderHolds..., R4_Arena_Step_HoldsWithinTheHoldAngle, R13_HeadHeldAgainstTheBorder... and R4_SlideAlongTheWall... now assert the D3 stop on the inset line (tolerance 1e-9) instead of one step short. RESULTS. dotnet full suite (--artifacts-path tools/CoreTests/.art/A7): 276 tests, 274 executed and passed, 0 failed; the 2 explicit BotReport cases pass when run separately (276/276). Test list vs Gate A: no test removed, one renamed (the R7 glide test above), 4 added (272 -> 276). Unity EditMode through tools/unity.ps1: JUnit tests=288 failures=0 errors=0 skipped=2 (275 Core + 13 B0 Runtime tests; the 2 skipped are the explicit BotReport cases; Capture_NoGridSizedAllocationPerCall is dotnet only). tools/verify.ps1 -Steps dotnet,editmode -Agent A7: PASS dotnet (total=276 passed=274 failed=0), PASS editmode (tests=288 failures=0 skipped=2 exit=0), OVERALL PASS (docs/verify_last.txt). A first editmode attempt failed with a transient compile error in a Runtime file mid-edit by a wave B agent; the next B0a run compiled cleanly and my retry passed. EventCapHits == 0 is asserted after every tick of every rule, scenario, audit and bot run (SimTestKit.AssertInvariants, BotTests.CheckInvariants): green. BOT TARGETS (50 seeds, dotnet, all asserted targets met, no preset retuned): lasso on captures per bot 25.30 / 24.34 / 20.46 / 30.74, cuts in 88 % of matches, Spark elimination in 68 %, TimeUp 96 %, mean coverage 40.6 %, 0 held ticks, escapable Spark eliminations 0 %; lasso off captures 23.88 / 23.28 / 18.64 / 29.70, cuts 92 %, Spark 72 %, TimeUp 88 %, coverage 39.1 %. Gate A (lasso on): 26.90 / 26.66 / 18.88 / 32.28, 88 %, 66 %, 94 %, 38.5 %. Reported only: trailing share 64-75 % (target 30-75 %); human-proxy fixture alive at the end 66 % (lasso on) / 70 % (off), target 35-75 % (Gate A 74-76 %), first 20 % / 16 %, target 15-45 %. PERF: CaptureSolver full-size box (rim loop, 230,848 cells) Unity 2.23 ms average (Gate A 2.40 ms, budget 3 ms), dotnet Release 2.32 ms average on a loaded machine; D1 adds one 3x3 scan per trail cell, a few thousand byte reads. 4-player bot tick in Unity: mean 19.9 us, p99 559 us, max 1.75 ms.

api_additions: Arena.HoldSnap (public const double 1e-11): a held head whose start satisfies SignedDistance + Margin >= -HoldSnap is already on the inset line and stays exactly in place (D3). No signature changed; Arena.Step keeps its signature and only its hold behaviour follows D3.
contract_issues: Base text still describes the pre-23.2 behaviour (23.2 overrides it, nothing to decide): section 7 step 5 says '4-adjacent', section 6 step a says 'Captures++' for every returner, R4 / 5.2 do not say that a held head first advances to the inset line, and the 5.5 PlayerState comment does not mention D2. 10.1 C1 'every trail cell 4-adjacent to the interior is captured' stays true (the 8-adjacency Rim is a superset). Suggested: fold 23.2 D1-D3 into those sections at the next contract revision.
open_issues: Counts: dotnet 274 executed + 2 explicit BotReport cases run separately = 276 green. Unity EditMode 288 tests, 286 executed, 0 failures (Core 275, Runtime 13).

Bot statistics moved slightly (D3 changes wall-hold paths and therefore the seeded rounds; D2 cannot move them because BotTests already counted only Returns with cells). Every asserted section 9 target is still met with margin and no preset was retuned.

Perf figures were taken while other wave B agents were building and testing: the Unity capture figure (2.23 ms) is under the 3 ms budget, the 4-player bot tick (mean 19.9 us, max 1.75 ms) is a little above Gate A's 13.3 us / 1.57 ms with different rounds. Android IL2CPP is still unmeasured (B6 probe).
D4 (tangency exactly at a tick end) stays a known limitation as decided in 23.2; not touched.

Two comments in A5-owned files still mention rim notches as if they were common: Bots/BotSenses.cs line 106 (edge point skips holes shorter than 1 u, 'a notch of the 4-adjacency rim') and Tests/EditMode/Core/BotTests.cs line 918 ('shorter ones are flickers through a notch of the edge'). Behaviour is still correct and still a useful guard; wording only.
needs: A5 / Bots owner (optional, wording only): update the notch comments in Bots/BotSenses.cs line 106 and BotTests.cs line 918 to say diagonal-edge notches no longer appear after a capture (contract 23.2 D1); the 1 u hole skip and the 0.5 s filter stay as guards.

B0 / B2 / B4 / B5: the 23.3 flicker debounce stays useful as a guard but the diagonal-edge flicker source is gone (0 Exit/Return pairs when gliding along a captured 45-degree edge); PlayerState.Captures now equals the number of Returns with cells (D2), so HUD and results stats may read it directly.
Contract owner: fold 23.2 D1-D3 into sections 5.2 (R4 / Arena.Step), 5.5 (PlayerState.Captures), 6 step a and 7 step 5.
